stock-pistol-barrage-two-routes.head: 6c5fb594
stock-pistol-barrage-two-routes.scope: Stock verified the two-second direct and queued dual-handgun paths, 19 and 17 typed damage, and naturally rolled Powerless with matched records.

damage.source: GOB 244 stores fixed Ballistic base 18. The legal level-27 dual-handgun profile applies its current Ballistic influence before typed recipient resistance.
damage.runtime: The free and interlocked routes use the same fixed health component and typed mitigation.
damage.test: TimedGunSpecialBindsItsEligibleTargetAndConsumesTypedResistance covers the 19 and 17 results. Stock landed 19 from rest and raw19/final17 through source1061 stat181 +20. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/865#issuecomment-7093847549

targeting.source: GOB 244 needs dual handguns, the Handguns style and a live selected hostile. It supplies direct and timed interlock use.
targeting.runtime: The normal handler binds the original view and spawn and carries the original interlock through queue resolution.
targeting.test: TimedGunSpecialQueuesAgainstTheOriginalInterlock and the timed weapon and target suite cover either route and its lifetime. Stock used both routes on the same target, including a fresh close-combat round after the armor application. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/865#issuecomment-7093847549

controls.source: The shipped effect gives eight seconds of Powerless at its authored probability and the distinct 734/681 control timer.
controls.runtime: The recipient state gates ability use and separately applies and retires its linked records and immunity.
controls.test: Stock witnessed 244/96, linked 96/0 and 734/681 with original-ID eight-second removals and one state-end. Soldier Upgrade was refused during Powerless and recovered after expiry. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/865#issuecomment-7093847549

proc.source: The shipped landing effect stores a 40% chance to apply Powerless after a hit.
proc.runtime: TimedEffects runs the preserved landing probability for the actual selected recipient.
proc.test: The executable threshold regression covers the authored chance. Stock observed the natural 277–279 records and the full refusal/recovery lifecycle. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/865#issuecomment-7093847549

244.note: Stock verified the authored +15 tactic and interlock 9519. The separately archived 9534 selector stays open. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/865#issuecomment-7093847549
